006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapItem;
017import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
018
019import java.util.List;
020import java.util.function.BiFunction;
021
022import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
023
024/**
025 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
026 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-map-for-each">map:for-each</a>
027 * function.
028 */
029public final class MapForEach {
030  private static final String NAME = "for-each";
031  @NonNull
032  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
033      .name(NAME)
034      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_MAP)
035      .deterministic()
036      .contextIndependent()
037      .focusIndependent()
038      .argument(IArgument.builder()
039          .name("map")
040          .type(IMapItem.type())
041          .one()
042          .build())
043      .argument(IArgument.builder()
044          .name("action")
045          .type(IFunction.type())
046          .one()
047          .build())
048      .returnType(IItem.type())
049      .returnZeroOrMore()
050      .functionHandler(MapForEach::execute)
051      .build();
052
053  private MapForEach() {
054    // disable construction
055  }
056
057  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
058  @NonNull
059  private static ISequence<?> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
060      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
061      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
062      IItem focus) {
063    IMapItem<?> map = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true)));
064    IFunction action = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(1).getFirstItem(true)));
065
066    BiFunction<IAnyAtomicItem, ISequence<?>, ISequence<?>> lambda = adaptFunction(action, dynamicContext);
067    return forEach(map, lambda);
068  }
069
070  /**
071   * Adapts the provided function call to a lambda expression for use with
072   * {@link #forEach(IMapItem, BiFunction)}.
073   *
074   * @param function
075   *          the function to adapt
076   * @param dynamicContext
077   *          the dynamic context for use in evaluating the function
078   * @return a lambda expression
079   */
080  @NonNull
081  private static BiFunction<IAnyAtomicItem, ISequence<?>, ISequence<?>> adaptFunction(
082      @NonNull IFunction function,
083      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
084    return (key, value) -> {
085      List<ISequence<?>> arguments = ObjectUtils.notNull(List.of(
086          ISequence.of(key),
087          value.toSequence()));
088
089      return function.execute(arguments, dynamicContext, ISequence.empty());
090    };
091  }
092
093  /**
094   * An implementation of XPath 3.1 <a href=
095   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-map-for-each">map:for-each</a>.
096   *
097   * @param map
098   *          the map of Metapath items that is the target of retrieval
099   * @param action
100   *          the action to perform on each entry in the map
101   * @return a stream resulting from concatenating the resulting streams provided
102   *         by the action result
103   */
104  @NonNull
105  public static ISequence<?> forEach(
106      @NonNull IMapItem<?> map,
107      @NonNull BiFunction<IAnyAtomicItem, ISequence<?>, ISequence<?>> action) {
108    return ISequence.of(ObjectUtils.notNull(map.entrySet().stream()
109        .flatMap(entry -> {
110          IAnyAtomicItem key = entry.getKey().getKey();
111          ISequence<?> values = entry.getValue().contentsAsSequence();
112          return action.apply(key, values).stream();
113        })));
114  }
115}
